text:
[LTIM.2.7.1] A positive pattern carrying a `within <dur>` recency window is
**time-dependent** per [LTIM.2.4.1]: the fact matches only while the monotonic
clock's sample is less than `<dur>` past the fact's entry stamp ([LTIM.2.8.6]),
and that truth changes as the clock advances with no fact activity. It is
re-evaluated on every tick under [LTIM.2.4].

**A `within` takes a positive duration.** A
pattern's `within_clause` ([LGRA.8.1]) whose duration is not positive is a
compile error (`DS_VALIDATE_ZERO_WITHIN`), whether the duration is written as a
duration literal or as a `time` const ([LGRA.2.8.1]), and whether the pattern
is positive or negated. On a positive pattern a zero window admits no fact, since
no fact is less than zero past its entry stamp, so the pattern never matches.
Under `no` it blocks on nothing, so the condition always holds. A `then` step's
window is refused the same way ([LTHE.4.7]).

idris.name: ltim_2_7_1__within_falls
idris.note: A `within` FALLS ONCE: for a fixed stamp, false at one monotonic sample, it is false at every later one, whatever the wall clock does -- the clause's 'that truth changes as the clock advances', and it changes once.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_1__within_three
idris.note: A PATTERN'S `within 3` as the lowering writes it: `dwell < 3`, the fact matching while the sample is less than 3 past its entry stamp. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__occupy
idris.note: A positive pattern carrying a `within` window, as the one timed node of its chain. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__within_fires_once
idris.note: 'The fact matches only while the monotonic clock's sample is less than `<dur>` past the fact's entry stamp': matched at 0 and 1, not at 4. Executed.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_1__within_at
idris.note: 'The fact matches only while the monotonic clock's sample is less than `<dur>` past the fact's entry stamp', at one sample.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_1__within_gate
idris.note: `within` as the time-dependent test the clause names: a function of the monotonic sample.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_1__within_gate_monotonic
idris.note: `within` is a function of the monotonic sample alone: a TRANSCRIPTION by construction.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_1__within
idris.note: `within <dur>`: the fact entered less than `dur` ago on the monotonic clock. Reduced to its clock dependence.
